title: plugin-security insert-check-post-image sqlite-wasm arm times out at 5000 ms on a saturated CI runner (first wasm boot)
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbdHk3orAeensH6EzS

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (CI on PR #37469 head `835c89df`, run 45780778844 attempt 1, job 139776420297 `Test Core (10/10)`; the #37413 dev's out-of-scope note in os-dev-report 7187229146). The finder files the flake.

Grading: `area:data` · reach: CI only — `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/insert-check-post-image.test.ts`, test "insert on driver-sqlite-wasm (:memory:) … the scoping field lands IN scope", ran into vitest's default 5000 ms timeout on the first sqlite-wasm boot of the file while the runner was saturated (import 1608 s, duration 842 s on that shard); 112 ms locally; green on the one re-run · evidence: measured once on CI, not reproduced locally.
Suggested-grade: p3 · a red shard on unrelated PRs, one re-run clears it.

## What

Give the sqlite-wasm arm a budget that does not depend on the shard's load: warm the wasm module once in a `beforeAll` (outside the per-test timeout) or set an explicit per-test timeout for the wasm arm with the reason in a comment. Do not raise the global timeout.

Related: PR #37469 (where it was met); #37429 (the other sqlite-wasm timing card, merged).
Dedupe: searched open issues for 'insert-check-post-image' — none.
